mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate trend signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend shows sustained decline over 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime, tight labor markets drive wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth, measured by quarterly GDP, indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment rate and increases in employment growth signal a tightening labor market, which accelerates wage growth and corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, elevated CPI readings prompt central bank rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
